\[\hskip 17.071654pt\begin{array}{c}\mbox{Re}_{2n}= \frac{\theta nB_{2n}s,h^{2n+3}}{\left(2k+2\right)!}\max_{x_{0}\leq x\leq x_{2n}}|f^{(4n+2)}(x)|,\quad(-1\leq\theta\leq 1)\end{array}\]

(For \(B_{2n}\), Bernoulli numbers, see chapter 23.)

If \(f^{(2n+2)}(x)\) and \(f^{(3n+4)}(x)\) do not change sign for \(x_{0}<x<x_{n}\) then \(|R_{2n}|\) is less than the first neglected term. If \(f^{(3n+2)}(x)\) does not change sign for \(x_{0}<x<x_{n}\), \(|R_{2n}|\) is less than twice the first neglected term.

Lagrange Formula

\[\int_{x}^{x_{0}}f(x)dx= \sum_{i=0}^{n}\left(L_{i}^{(n)}(b)-L_{i}^{(n)}(a)\right)f_{i}+R_{n}\]

(See 25.2.1.)

\[L_{i}^{(n)}(x)= \frac{1}{\pi_{x}^{*}(x_{i})}\int_{x_{0}}^{x}\frac{\pi_{x}(t)}{t-x_{i}} dt= \int_{x_{0}}^{x}l_{i}(t)dt\]

\[25.4.10\;\;R_{n}= \frac{1}{(n+1)!}\int_{x}^{x}\pi_{x}(x)f^{(n+1)}(\xi(x))dx\]
